title: Preserved procedural actor soup generic-greedy fresh5k Slumbot
benchmark: A frozen learned policy plays at least 100,000 fresh 200bb HUNL Slumbot hands, scores above 0 bb/100, and has a 95% confidence-interval lower bound above 0.
hypothesis: The frozen alpha0.75 procedural-training actor soup, which passed parent-state preservation and fresh procedural-family qualification, will improve generic-greedy external transfer enough to produce a positive fresh5k Slumbot point estimate.
material_change: Freeze exact learned checkpoint SHA256 66c2254d96e36710c1b326d17026099e6ccabdec70d8e2333cfbef26a63c4a6c. Run exactly eight simultaneous new independent generic-greedy Slumbot sessions of625 hands with seeds2026111101-08 and unique session IDs. No retries, replacement, continuation, endpoint change, score stopping, or extension. Compute bb/100 and raw/session CIs solely from5000 durable raw hand JSONL rows; require full decision, terminal, server-counter, token-chain, and session-independence audits.
baseline: Same execution contract raw parent fresh5k was -9.4188 bb/100 with wide raw95%CI; historical Standard10 greedy20k was -11.4275, while strict sampled was -48.9778. Comparisons are historical and unpaired. The current policy internal procedural delta was +6.6091 with paired CI above zero.
notes: Pilot admission to a separate non-pooled fresh20k requires aggregate bb/100>0 and at least4/8 positive session means. These5000 hands can never be counted toward the final100k qualification.

Independent review recomputed all statistics from5000 raw hand rows, verified exact greedy argmax/one-hot behavior and terminal evidence, and found no overlap with90 token hashes from12 prior PASS audits.

result.summary: Exact frozen policy completed eight fresh625 generic-greedy Slumbot sessions at +9.0452 bb/100, raw95%CI[-56.1257,74.2161], session-t7 CI[-50.8105,68.9009], with5/8 positive sessions. All5000 raw hands and decisions passed audit; token chains were disjoint from prior cohorts.
result.conclusion: The preserved procedural actor soup cleared the preregistered fresh5k point/session gate and improved the historical raw-parent point by18.464 bb/100, but uncertainty remains far too wide and the pilot cannot count toward final qualification.
result.next_step: Run the same frozen SHA256 66c2254d96e36710c1b326d17026099e6ccabdec70d8e2333cfbef26a63c4a6c for exactly20000 new generic-greedy Slumbot hands in8 independent2500-hand sessions. Do not pool pilot hands. Require raw evidence/session audits; only a positive point with materially improved uncertainty should justify100k qualification.
